title: Special Theft Limits and Depreciation Holdback Terms for CondoGuard Claims
content:
Claim figures of the CondoGuard Unit-Owners Policy set by tier: the special limits for theft of certain property and for money, the replacement-cost amount at or below which no depreciation is withheld, and the recovery period for withheld depreciation.

## Special limits (USD)

| Tier | Theft of jewelry, watches and furs | Theft of firearms | Money |
|---|---|---|---|
| CondoGuard HO-6 Named Perils Essential | 1500 | 2500 | 200 |
| CondoGuard HO-6 Named Perils Enhanced | 1500 | 2500 | 200 |
| CondoGuard HO-6 Special Essential | 2500 | 2500 | 200 |
| CondoGuard HO-6 Special Enhanced | 2500 | 5000 | 500 |
| CondoGuard HO-6 Special Premier | 5000 | 5000 | 500 |
| CondoGuard HO-6 Special Signature | 10000 | 10000 | 1000 |

## Holdback terms

| Tier | Replacement-cost amount per coverage part at or below which no depreciation is withheld (USD) | Days after the actual-cash-value payment to document repair or replacement (calendar days) |
|---|---|---|
| CondoGuard HO-6 Named Perils Essential | 0 | 180 |
| CondoGuard HO-6 Named Perils Enhanced | 1000 | 180 |
| CondoGuard HO-6 Special Essential | 1000 | 365 |
| CondoGuard HO-6 Special Enhanced | 2500 | 365 |
| CondoGuard HO-6 Special Premier | 2500 | 365 |
| CondoGuard HO-6 Special Signature | 10000 | 730 |

## Illustrations (hypothetical amounts)

- On CondoGuard HO-6 Special Enhanced a coverage part with a replacement-cost amount of exactly 2500 USD is at the threshold, so no depreciation is withheld; at 2500.01 USD it is above the threshold.
- On CondoGuard HO-6 Named Perils Essential the threshold is 0, so any coverage part with a replacement-cost amount above 0 is above it.
- The special limit for theft of jewelry, watches and furs rises from 1500 USD on the two Named Perils tiers to 10000 USD on CondoGuard HO-6 Special Signature.
